chapters.text: Every day a full copy of all Bitrix leads, activities, comments and stage history is saved in Google Drive and can be downloaded to your computer.
Connect Bitrix in Settings → CRM → Bitrix sync, and (for the long history) Google Drive in Settings → Backup.
On the Bitrix sync page, the Full Bitrix backup card is on by default; press Back up now for the first one. It works without Google Drive too.
Download to your computer: the newest 3 backups are listed on the card with Download buttons, each an Excel file and a complete copy (.json.gz). Super Admins only.
In Drive, open AMS backups → Bitrix backups: an Excel file (Leads, Activities, Comments, Stage history, People) and a complete copy of every field (.json.gz) for each day.
Old copies are removed after the days set in Settings → Backup. Super Admins are told if a backup fails.
